info.name: Credential Service
info.description:
Team 16 - Student ID, please. Credential Service owns the documents an applicant presents and each document's validation status.

Run the folders in order: 'Contract endpoints' stores an applicant_id that the later folders reuse. Set base_url to wherever the service is listening (8082 by default).

The single most important assertion in here is in 'Documents (what players see)': the player-facing endpoint must never return validation_status or problems.

item.name: Through the Gateway
item.description: In the running system nothing calls Credential Service directly: every request enters at the Gateway as `{{gateway_url}}/api/v1/credential/...`, which checks the credential, removes it and forwards the rest to the service's `/api/v1/...` (CPR README, Gateway and Authentication). A service call carries `X-Service-Token`; a player's carries `Authorization: Bearer <jwt>`, which this folder's pre-request script mints for `player_id` with `jwt_secret`. `service_token` and `jwt_secret` must match the Gateway's SERVICE_TOKEN and JWT_SECRET, and the Gateway must reach the service as CREDENTIAL_URL. The policy per route is the Gateway's; the service itself checks no credential, which is why `/documents/validation` is safe only behind it.

exec: // Player tokens, signed the way Player Service signs them: HS256 with JWT_SECRET, `sub` = the
// player's id, `iat` and `exp`. The Gateway verifies the signature, so `jwt_secret` must be the
// JWT_SECRET of the Gateway being called (gateway-service/.env).
return header + '.' + payload + '.' + b64url(CryptoJS.HmacSHA256(header + '.' + payload, secret));
pm.collectionVariables.set('player_token', mint({ sub: sub, iat: now, exp: now + 3600 }, secret));

request.description: `/api/v1/credential/health` is forwarded to the service's `/health`: a public route, no credential, not counted as a task. The Gateway adds `X-Request-ID` when the caller sent none.
Readiness leaks dependency state, so the Gateway forwards it only with the service token; without one it answers 403 SERVICE_TOKEN_REQUIRED.
